description: This file contains utility classes and functions for implementing stateful processing with transformWithState in PySpark, including handling of different processing modes, timer expirations, and initial states.

classes.name: TransformWithStateInPandasFuncMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different modes of transformWithState processing: PROCESS_DATA, PROCESS_TIMER, COMPLETE, PRE_INIT.

classes.name: TransformWithStateInPandasUdfUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to handle transformWithState UDF logic, including processing data rows, timers, and initial states.

methods.name: transformWithStateUDF
methods.description: Main method to process input rows or timers based on the mode, managing state initialization, timer expiration, and completion.

methods.name: transformWithStateWithInitStateUDF
methods.description: Handles transformWithState with initial states, processing input rows and initial states together.

methods.name: _handle_pre_init
methods.description: Handles pre-initialization logic for the stateful processor, mainly for driver-side setup.

methods.name: _handle_data_rows
methods.description: Processes input data rows for a given key, setting implicit key and timestamps.

methods.name: _handle_expired_timers
methods.description: Processes expired timers based on the time mode, emitting related rows.
